text:
sara-platform: Quick async: we need clarity on the dedicated capacity reservation failover routing + SLA implications. Who owns the failover policy doc and the rollback/canary windows for wave-3?

maria-eng: I can own the doc. Question: do we default to region fallback + model-variant downgrade, or allow pinned customers to opt out?

rahul-infra: FYI vendor pushed H100 wave-3 by ~48h. New ETA 2026-03-19 for the last rack. That shifts staging->prod handoff and may force fallback for some reservations in us-west.

nina-sre: If we do cross-region failover we need to call out SLO impact explicitly — expect +50-120ms p95 depending on region. Also we should add an explicit canary to limit blast radius.

kevin-ops: Ops requires 72h notice to move committed capacity between regions/customers. For automatic short-failovers (<24h) we can do post-event comms but customers might complain. Need wording for customer notifications.

sara-platform: Good points. Maria, please draft a policy with: (1) automatic fallback chain (region -> variant -> queued), (2) notification windows (24h/72h), (3) canary step + rollback criteria. Drop draft in /drive/infra/failover and ping this thread.

maria-eng: Drafted an initial YAML snippet, PTAL.

```yaml
failover_policy:
  primary: us-west
  fallback:
    - us-east # latency_penalty_ms: 80
    - eu-west # latency_penalty_ms: 120
  model_variant_order:
    - quantized_v1
    - fp16_small
notification_windows:
  pre_notify: 24h
  ops_commit: 72h
canary:
  traffic_pct: 5
  duration: 1h
rollback:
  health_check_failures: 3
  latency_increase_threshold_pct: 40
```

rahul-infra: Looks reasonable. Two infra action items: (1) update envoy routing table rollout to support fallback chains, (2) reserve cross-region egress bandwidth for expected failover traffic. I'll open infra tickets INFRA-412 and INFRA-413 and link them in the doc.

nina-sre: Please add an automated alarm: when failure_rate > 1% AND latency_increase > 40% during canary -> abort and rollback. Also add a runbook step to revert routing within 15m.

kevin-ops: For customer comms: ops will prepare two templates — pre-notify (72h) and short-notify (post-event for <24h). Also need a concise SLA clause. Legal/sales required to sign off on any change from 'SLA-backed' to "best-effort" fallback.

sara-platform: I'll loop in @elaine-sales and @tom-legal for wording. For now mark SLA change as "best-effort" until they confirm.

maria-eng: Updated doc with canary + alerts, pushed to /drive/infra/failover/v1.md. Added links to INFRA-412/413 under action items.

deploy-bot: [deploy] envoy-config failover-rules v3 staged to staging cluster at 2951235567.

rahul-infra: INFRA-412 created for egress reservations; INFRA-413 created for envoy rollout playbook. I'll attach capacity numbers.

sara-platform: Next steps and owners: Maria (policy doc finalization), Rahul (infra tickets + bandwidth reservation), Nina (canary runbook + alert rules), Kevin (ops templates + customer comms), Sara (coordinate legal/sales). Target: finalize by 2026-03-18 for wave-3 decision. If wave-3 slips further we re-evaluate.

maria-eng: ack — I'll have the doc ready by EOD 2026-03-16.

nina-sre: I'll start the canary runbook tomorrow and post the checklist here.

kevin-ops: Ops templates in progress, will add sample email + timeline to the drive doc.

sara-platform: thanks everyone. If no objections, this is the proposed approach. :thumbsup:
